payload.reason: The evidence provides clear results comparing word and morpheme segmentation performance under different supervision conditions.

claims.text: In unsupervised settings, segmentation metrics are better with morpheme-based references, indicating a tendency to oversegment with word-based references.
With word supervision, better performance is observed for word-level metrics, while morpheme-based scores decrease, showing a shift in behavior based on the type of supervision.
Morpheme supervision leads to improved word segmentation but does not improve morpheme boundary detection, highlighting the complexity of segmentation tasks.
